findings.message: Public test case '# ##' fails: candidate returns title '##' instead of expected empty string. This violates the specified contract that a terminal run of hashes separated from the preceding title by a space/tab is a closing marker, not part of the title.

Candidate regex `^(?P<marker>#{1,6})[ \t]+(?P<text>.*?)(?:(?<=\S)[ \t]+#*|[ \t]*)[ \t]*$` does not differentiate between an attached hash suffix and a closing hash run. It captures all-hash text as the title when no closing run is present, leading to the failure in '# ##' and also incorrectly emptying titles such as '# #' when a closing run follows.

conclusion.summary: The candidate implementation fails to correctly handle ATX heading titles that end with an attached hash suffix that is not a closing marker. The current regex incorrectly treats such text as the title, causing public contract violations. A fix requires adjusting the regex to capture a separate closing hash run group and adding logic to set the title to an empty string when the captured title consists solely of hashes and no closing run is present.
